ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible fluke surface, contrasted with low-intensity black pixels localized on the leading edges and distal tips of the trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white region covering the center and inner lobes. Solid black pigmentation observed along the leading edge of the left lobe and trailing margins of both lobes. Distinct, small, low-intensity circular mottling spots distributed across the distal region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization localized along the distal leading edge of the left lobe, creating an irregular, protruding physical profile.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized patches of yellowish-brown surface discoloration (likely diatom accumulation) on the white ventral surface of the left lobe, proximal to the leading edge.
